      "source": [
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "\n",
        "# Đọc hai file\n",
        "df_weather = pd.read_csv(\"/content/pothole_with_weather.csv\")\n",
        "\n",
        "df_labeled = pd.read_csv(\n",
        "    \"/content/pothole_weather_labeled_90d_2.csv\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Kiểm tra kích thước\n",
        "print(\"===== WEATHER DATA =====\")\n",
        "print(\"Shape:\", df_weather.shape)\n",
        "print(df_weather.info())\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\n===== LABELED 90D DATA =====\")\n",
        "print(\"Shape:\", df_labeled.shape)\n",
        "print(df_labeled.info())"
      ]
    },

        "})\n",
        "\n",
        "missing_table = missing_table.sort_values(\n",
        "    by=\"Missing Percent (%)\",\n",
        "    ascending=False\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"===== MISSING DATA ASSESSMENT =====\")\n",
        "print(missing_table.to_string())"

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "print(\"===== RELIABILITY ASSESSMENT =====\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# 1. Kiểm tra bản ghi trùng lặp\n",
        "print(\n",
        "    \"Duplicate rows:\",\n",
        "    df_labeled.duplicated().sum()\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\n",
        "    \"Duplicate request IDs:\",\n",
        "    df_labeled[\"SERVICE REQUEST NUMBER\"].duplicated().sum()\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# 2. Kiểm tra ngày không hợp lệ\n",
        "df_labeled[\"COMPLETION DATE\"] = pd.to_datetime(\n",
        "    df_labeled[\"COMPLETION DATE\"],\n",
        "    errors=\"coerce\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "invalid_dates = df_labeled[\n",
        "    df_labeled[\"COMPLETION DATE\"] <\n",
        "    df_labeled[\"CREATION DATE\"]\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Invalid completion dates:\", len(invalid_dates))\n",
        "\n",
        "# 3. Kiểm tra tọa độ\n",
        "invalid_coordinates = df_labeled[\n",
        "    (~df_labeled[\"LATITUDE\"].between(-90, 90)) |\n",
        "    (~df_labeled[\"LONGITUDE\"].between(-180, 180))\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Invalid coordinates:\", len(invalid_coordinates))\n",
        "\n",
        "# 4. Kiểm tra dữ liệu thời tiết\n",
        "print(\n",
        "    \"Negative rain_sum:\",\n",
        "    (df_labeled[\"rain_sum\"] < 0).sum()\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\n",
        "    \"Humidity outside 0-100:\",\n",
        "    (\n",
        "        (df_labeled[\"humidity\"] < 0) |\n",
        "        (df_labeled[\"humidity\"] > 100)\n",
        "    ).sum()\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# 5. Kiểm tra nhãn 90 ngày\n",
        "print(\n",
        "    \"event_90d unique values:\",\n",
        "    sorted(df_labeled[\"event_90d\"].dropna().unique())\n",
        ")"
      ],

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "required_columns = [\n",
        "    \"CREATION DATE\",\n",
        "    \"COMPLETION DATE\",\n",
        "    \"LOCATION_ID\",\n",
        "    \"LATITUDE\",\n",
        "    \"LONGITUDE\",\n",
        "    \"previous_pothole_count\",\n",
        "    \"days_since_previous\",\n",
        "    \"rain_sum\",\n",
        "    \"rain_7d\",\n",
        "    \"rain_30d\",\n",
        "    \"temperature\",\n",
        "    \"humidity\",\n",
        "    \"followup_days\",\n",
        "    \"event_90d\"\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "completeness_result = []\n",
        "\n",
        "for col in required_columns:\n",
        "    completeness_result.append({\n",
        "        \"Column\": col,\n",
        "        \"Available\": col in df_labeled.columns,\n",
        "        \"Non-Missing\": (\n",
        "            df_labeled[col].notna().sum()\n",
        "            if col in df_labeled.columns else 0\n",
        "        ),\n",
        "        \"Completeness (%)\": (\n",
        "            round(df_labeled[col].notna().mean() * 100, 2)\n",
        "            if col in df_labeled.columns else 0\n",
        "        )\n",
        "    })\n",
        "\n",
        "completeness_table = pd.DataFrame(completeness_result)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(completeness_table.to_string(index=False))"
      ],

        "\n",
        "year_counts = (\n",

        "    .value_counts()\n",
        "    .sort_index()\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))\n",
        "year_counts.plot(kind=\"bar\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.title(\"Number of Pothole Reports by Year\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Year\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Number of Reports\")\n",
        "plt.xticks(rotation=45)\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()"
